stories.headline: OpenAI fires three researchers after inquiry
stories.summary: OpenAI says three researchers violated sensitive-information rules and were dismissed after an internal investigation. The researchers say the action may chill safety concerns; OpenAI says the firings were unrelated to raising safety issues.

stories.headline: Firmus scraps $5 billion Australian IPO
stories.summary: Nvidia-backed Firmus shelved its offering after investors questioned its valuation, debt, execution record and a partner's exit. Firmus will seek private capital; a possible Nasdaq listing remains unconfirmed.

stories.headline: Poll: 78% blame Trump policies for rising prices
stories.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found 78% of US adults assign some blame to Trump policies for rising prices, including majorities across parties. The poll measures opinion, not a causal economic estimate; overall margin of error was two points.

stories.headline: Riyadh airport attacks kill three Saudis
stories.summary: Saudi authorities said Houthi attacks on Riyadh's airport killed three Saudis, injured several people and damaged an aircraft. Flights resumed, but the strikes mark a serious expansion of the regional conflict.

stories.headline: UNCTAD cuts 2026 global growth forecast
stories.summary: UNCTAD projects 2.6% global growth in 2026, down from 2.9% in 2025, citing the Middle East energy shock. Its estimate differs modestly from the IMF and World Bank because institutions use different assumptions and timing.
